answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 3457 Country: United Kingdom Title: A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. Question: Assalamu Alaikum I hope you are all well, A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. Jazzakallah Answer ID: 3457 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 409/364=D) You shall have the honour of serving Ulama and pious Muslim leaders and you shall compete others in this regard, in-sha-Allah. (2) You shall get academic and spiritual benefit from him and shall get chances to benefit from the Ulama. (3) People shall be benefited by your religious services. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
